scripts.dev: npm run build -w @arena/contracts && npm run build -w @arena/domain && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @arena/server" "npm run dev -w @arena/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @arena/contracts && npm run build -w @arena/domain && npm run build -w @arena/web && npm run build -w @arena/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @arena/contracts && npm run build -w @arena/domain && npm run build -w @arena/server && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
